The Bombay High Court has released an official notification inviting applications for various positions, including Clerk, Peon, and other roles. The recruitment drive is being conducted through an online application process hosted via the official portal.

Candidates interested in applying for these positions must review the detailed notification directly from the source to understand the complete set of rules, mandatory prerequisites, and submission timelines.

Overview of Eligibility and Age Limits

According to the available details from the official notification framework, applicants must meet specific criteria regarding age and qualifications:

  • Age Limit: The eligible age range for applicants is generally set between 18 and 38 years. Exact category-wise relaxations or specific limits are detailed in the official notification.
  • Educational Qualifications: Depending on the specific post applied for, educational requirements generally range from a 10th-grade pass to holding a graduation degree. Candidates should consult the official document to match their specific qualifications to the desired post.

Application Process and Fee

Applications are accepted exclusively through online modes. Prospective candidates are advised to download and read the official notification thoroughly before registering.

  • Register on the official portal using valid contact details, including a functional email address and phone number for future communications.
  • Fill out the application form with accurate personal and educational details.
  • Upload scanned copies of required documents, which typically include identity proofs, mark sheets, and certificates.
  • Complete the submission by paying the application fee of ₹1,000, where applicable.

Selection procedures for the roles may involve tests such as typing or shorthand evaluations, depending on the requirements of the specific position.

Practical Implications and What Readers Can Verify

When applying for government notifications, applicants should ensure all submitted documents are accurate and valid. Providing incorrect contact information or failing to meet deadlines will result in the rejection of the application.

  • What is Confirmed: The issuance of the notification by the Bombay High Court for roles including Clerk and Peon, the online application mode, an application fee requirement of ₹1,000, and general educational parameters ranging from 10th standard to graduation.
  • What Remains Unknown: Specific reservation break-downs, exact closing dates for submissions, and detailed exam schedules must be verified directly from the source text.

Readers can check the original announcement, download the notification, and verify all official updates by visiting the [Bombay High Court Recruitment 2025 Source](https://sarkarikyp.com/bombay-high-court-recruitment-2025-all-details-eligibility-age-limit-important-dates-and-more/).
